items.text: delivery nahi mili
driver nahi mil raha
address kaha hai
haan ji
wait kar raha hu
abhi tak
kya hua
kya karu
nahi mila paise

items.context: Did the delivery person contact you?
items.text: nahi mila

items.context: Is the delivery person able to find your address?
items.text: nahi samajh aaye

items.context: Is the delivery person available now?
items.text: busy hai
delivery wala call nahi kar raha hai
driver apna mobile nahi utha raha
address thik se nahi mila driver ko
kya aap driver se baat karwa sakte hain
mera order kal dena tha par abhi tak nahi aaya
main apne ghar pe hoon par driver mil nahi raha
plz driver ko bol do call kare mujhe

items.context: Can you tell me if you have spoken to the driver?
items.text: driver kaha hai aapko pata hai

items.context: Can you give the address again?
items.text: main ne apna address deta hu aap driver ko bol dena

items.context: If the driver is unreachable, what can we do?
items.text: kya aap order cancel kar sakte ho agar driver nahi milta

items.context: The driver is not answering your call?
items.text: driver mera phone nahi utha raha kya karu

items.context: Has there been any delay in delivery?
items.text: delivery time mein delay hua kya
main ne order diya tha sector 12 Gurgaon mein par driver abhi tak call nahi karta
delivery boy ko samajh nahi aa raha mera address kaha hai main ne pura address bheja hai
kya aap please driver ko bol sakte ho ki mera phone uthaye aur mujhe delivery kare

items.context: Can you confirm the delivery boy contacted you?
items.text: main ne aapko address diya tha chhattarpur Delhi, lekin delivery boy driver mujhe call nahi kar raha hai baar baar phone karne ke baad bhi

items.context: Do you know where the driver is right now?
items.text: driver kaha hai mujhe nahi pata, main ne toh order online place kiya tha aur kab se driver mil nahi raha

items.context: Is there any confusion with the address?
items.text: address ko lekar driver confused hai, main ne Lokhandwala Mumbai mein diya tha, par wo bula raha hai ki koi nahi mil raha

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: agent_unreachable - the delivery person is not answering or cannot find the address
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
